title: Pre-Existing Conditions under Trip Protection
content:
Under Trip Protection a condition is pre-existing when it falls within the plan's look-back period: the stated number of days before the plan was purchased. Some plans include a pre-existing condition waiver, under which pre-existing conditions are covered when the plan is bought in time; the time allowed is a number of calendar days after the stay was booked.

## Provisions by plan

| Plan | Look-back period (days before purchase in which a condition counts as pre-existing) | Pre-existing condition waiver included | Waiver purchase period (calendar days after booking within which the plan must be bought for the waiver) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 60 | no | 0 |
| Trip Protection Essential | 60 | no | 0 |
| Trip Protection Standard | 60 | no | 0 |
| Trip Protection Plus | 60 | yes | 14 |
| Trip Protection Premier | 60 | yes | 14 |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 60 | yes | 14 |

## Provisions in clause form

1. **Look-back.** On every Trip Protection plan, a condition counts as pre-existing when it falls in the 60 days before the plan was purchased.
2. **Waiver.** Trip Protection Plus, Trip Protection Premier and Trip Protection Premier CFAR include the pre-existing condition waiver, with a waiver purchase period of 14 calendar days after booking. On these plans pre-existing conditions are covered when the plan was bought within that period.
3. **No waiver.** Trip Cancellation Only, Trip Protection Essential and Trip Protection Standard do not include the waiver; their waiver purchase period shows 0.

## Points of judgement on hypothetical facts

| Plan bought | Bought how long after booking | Waiver included on the plan | Bought within the waiver purchase period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Protection Plus | 9 calendar days | yes | yes (within 14) |
| Trip Protection Premier | 20 calendar days | yes | no (beyond 14) |
| Trip Protection Standard | 2 calendar days | no | not applicable: the plan has no waiver |
